authors: read-only Gold Methodology Auditor (same model family, not human consensus)
basis: predeclared financial comparability predicates and independently authored synthetic arithmetic, never strategy/Runtime success

knownRepair.preferred: normalize.units only when known same-currency scale and no other blocker
knownRepair.reason: permitted notes supply consistent units; acquisition is reasonable but costs one reading unit

acceptance.calculate: Exactly one supported statement per target period, positive revenue and nonnegative gross profit, safe integers, matching metadata and units; finite alone is insufficient in this contract.
acceptance.normalize: only known same-currency scale mismatch and otherwise comparable
acceptance.read: published authorized relevant period/scope catalog and a visible unresolved issue, including convertible scale
acceptance.inspect: one independent comparability inspection for unresolved state and relevant catalog
acceptance.revisions: visible multiple editions and published restatement-note
acceptance.stop: unresolved issues with no available safe resolving read or normalization

preference.scope: same task, same initial policy and budget, independently successful same terminal class and same fact answer; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

disputes.decision: legal but redundant in this narrow task, not unacceptable financial assertion

facts: hand-authored task margins/change only; unavailable source bodies never support assertions
completion: localJustifiedStop is separate from task-level correct stop; authored terminalGold must support insufficiency under the fixed experiment budget; self-induced exhaustion on a solvable task is not independent success
